description.value: Glen Lake Liquor & More is a liquor and convenience store situated on Sooke Road in the Glen Lake area west of Victoria. It sits along a popular cycling corridor connecting the city to the Highlands and Sooke, making it a practical stop for riders heading in or out of town. The 'More' in its name suggests a convenience offering beyond spirits and beer.
